title: Cosmic Portal Experiment
description: A surreal steampunk scene shows a man in a trench coat and hat standing on a metallic platform, holding a glowing orb connected by lightning to a massive transparent sphere containing three swirling vortexes in pink, blue and green. Below are toxic barrels, a wooden crate, a gnarled dead tree, and a human skull at his feet.
prompt: A surreal scene featuring a man in a dark trench coat and hat standing on a metallic platform connected to a giant transparent sphere. Inside the sphere are three glowing swirling vortexes in vibrant pink, blue, and green. Yellow lightning arcs between the orbs. At the base are toxic barrels, a wooden crate, a gnarled leafless tree, and a human skull. The entire apparatus sits on a large metallic tank with dripping toxic liquid. Dark cosmic background with floating spirals, painted in a vibrant psychedelic style with heavy brush textures.
